comparisons.name: corner-top-light
comparisons.description: Top-left corner of the Sound pane's box on the window background, Aqua. Threshold 0.02, because the border is too faint for a higher one to count any pixel: at 0.02 a change of 0.05 in the top border's alpha fails. The budgets are set for --mac-radius-group at 4px, the value the measured spec fits to this box (3.875 pt in Aqua, 4.0 pt in Dark Aqua): at the earlier 2.5px about 0.25% of the 2x pixels differ here and the comparison fails.

comparisons.name: well-corner-top-light
comparisons.description: Top-left corner of the summary box in Activity Monitor's footer (variant=well) on the footer's background, Aqua: the 1 pt border, the 4.5 pt corner and the white fill. The crop is 14 x 28 pt: it ends before the first statistic's text. The budgets are set for the 4.5 pt corner: at 4 pt 0.45% of the 2x pixels differ here and the comparison fails.
